answer: Route trust as a max-flow through a vouching graph: honest standing reaches a newcomer only across the thin inlet of edges that genuine peers extend. A sybil cluster, however many sable masks it spins up, is capped by the capacity of that cut, so flooding fakes past the bottleneck fails and real trust stays scarce as a single lotus. An attacker must corrupt true vouchers one by one; cost scales with honest edges bought, not identities minted.
